reviews.title: Good in theory - not the best in execution
reviews.text:
It works, I’ve managed to wake up with it. The choice of things to do is good 
Issue it, it’s a complete battery drain which renders it useless if it kills your phone in the night.

And even then, if you don’t have time to charge your phone form it’s dying state when you wake up, you’re screwed. 

Would be genuinely perfect if it didn’t drain my phone so bad, 20% I can deal with, but when I wake up and I’m on 0-30% it’s an issue and isn’t worth the risk.

reviews.title: Reliable alarms but awful battery usage.
reviews.text: I downloaded this app a couple of months ago to combat the awful Apple alarms that never seem to go off. It worked a treat and helps me wake up on time every single day and it also has a medication/habit alarm that goes off every night and has been amazing for keeping me on track with my meds. HOWEVER, recently I noticed that my phone kept dying in the middle of the night despite it being on around 80% battery before I went to sleep. It happened frequently enough that I checked my battery usage in my settings and was surprised to see that the app is using up to 50% of my battery every charge when my phone isn’t even on nor is the app even open. I’ve had to delete it for this reason. So just watch out for that, the premise of the alarms becomes absolutely useless when your phone dies before the alarm even gets a chance to go off…

reviews.title: HEAVILY Shaming Users
reviews.text: I downloaded this app a long time ago and have loved it since then. As someone who struggles to wake up, it’s been a Godsend. I NEVER write reviews and haven’t written a positive one for that reason. However, this latest feature deeply disturbs me. When using the “Say Out Loud” setting, their newest game to open the alarm, I’m made to say sentences aloud that are demeaning and untrue. For example, despite hand selecting the 16 sentences I wanted used, I would be asked to say the same 4 phrases- notably “This is my fault, I am stupid”. I’m in graduate school. I work. I’m a caretaker. A dog mom. Planning a wedding. It’s incredibly hurtful that the first thing I say out loud about myself when waking up is that I am STUPID for being asleep and that it’s my fault, that I’m to blame. I’ve double checked- I don’t have these sentences checked off to use NOR are they even sentence options in the choices, so why are we getting such hateful messages? I’m using this app as a solution, and even though I don’t use that game anymore, I’m still about to delete the app. I don’t want to support a company using shame to wake people up, especially when there is false control over being able to select which sentences are used only for the user to receive the same 4 sentences over and over. I don’t have an issue with the out loud feature itself, I just think you should really look into what the responses are being given to users as this feels hurtful and honestly intentional on the companies part

reviews.title: Charged lifetime subscription half awake
reviews.text: I am very disappointed at the recent changes to this app that I have used for over two years now. The new user interface and changes to the app have made the subscriptions pop up predatory.  I was trying to finish a math challenge and was barely awake, as I was trying to turn off the next alarm because I ran out of time falling back asleep, the app popped up the subscriptions option as the next alarm went off and with my eyes closed I hit the lock button to snooze the alarm and the app SUBSCRIBED ME FOR 167$ for a lifetime when I was BARELY awake. I do not have money now to pay an important bill due today, and am broke now till this appeal return goes through in 48 hours. I am extremely disappointed and livid that an app that I’ve enjoyed for free and never had a problem with when I’ve had it, has now done such a thing as to take advantage of the users who are trying to wake up and likely am not the only person this is happening to. I want to continue using the app for free but even if I get a refund the UX has become terrible and it’s setup now to take advantage of those on the free version. I’m appalled and I did not want to start my day like this especially when finances are hard right now.
